Main content

Unforgettable travel experiences—GetYourGuide

GetYourGuide is the best place to find unforgettable travel experiences across the whole world. We have over 60,000 experiences, locally tested and curated by experts, so you don’t miss a single unforgettable discovery, whether planned or unplanned.

Book now The link will be opened in a new browser tab

4 miles for every euro spent

  • Authentic experiences—follow your curiosity, feel the joy of discovery, and see more of the world.
  • Flexible bookings—make plans on the move and book whenever the fancy takes you. Discover the world in your own way.
  • Discover the possibilities—make the most of personalized recommendations and travel routes with over 60,000 tours, sights, and more.

How to earn miles with GetYourGuide

On every booking via GetYourGuide you’ll earn four miles for every euro you spend. Simply enter your Miles & More service card number when booking and the miles will be credited to you automatically 14 days after your tour.

A good journey starts with the right preparation

Whether you travel by train, by your own car, or stay digitally connected on the go: a range of services help make your journey to and from the airport, as well as your time at your destination, as comfortable as possible. Travel with Rail&Fly from selected railway stations in Germany directly to your flight and back again. If you arrive by car, you can reserve your airport parking space conveniently at the terminal. And with car sharing, you remain flexible and mobile at your destination. In addition, an eSIM ensures reliable connectivity throughout your trip.

HomeBaggageElectronic devices and batteries

Main content

Electronic devices and batteries

Personal electronic devices and batteries are classed as dangerous goods. This is because, if damaged, they can generate heat, short-circuit and start a fire.

You can find detailed information for your personal electronic devices and batteries here. The symbols show you whether and under what conditions you are permitted to take them with you:

In or as checked baggage

In or as carry-on baggage or personal item in the cabin

On your person

Transport approval required

NOT in or as checked baggage

NOT in or as carry-on baggage or personal item in the cabin

Transport prohibited

It is not permitted to carry with you defective or damaged personal electronic devices or batteries, or any such items recalled by the manufacturer for safety reasons.

The list of electronic devices and batteries is not exhaustive and can be expanded at any time.

The power of lithium-ion batteries is specified in watt hours (Wh). The lithium content (LC) is stated for lithium metal batteries.

Conversion aid for battery power:

  • watt hours (Wh) = ampere hours (Ah) x voltage (V); or
  • watt hours (Wh) = milliampere hours (mAh) x voltage (V) / 1,000.

Permitted in or as checked baggage (not recommended)

Permitted in or as carry-on baggage in the cabin

Power restriction: max. 100 Wh or 2 g LC per device

Item restriction: max. 15 devices with batteries per passenger

Portable electronic devices for personal use are:

  • laptops, mobile phones, tablets,
  • electric toiletry items (toothbrushes, razors, etc.), 
  • electric toys, 
  • drones, watches, calculators; or 
  • other entertainment or communication electronics.

Such items should be carried in your carry-on baggage whenever possible.

General transport regulations:

  • Protect the device from damage.
  • Protect the device from unintentional activation, or remove the battery and isolate the connections to prevent a short circuit.
  • If you are transporting several devices, stow your devices separately from each other (e.g. separated by clothing or the original packaging).

Additional transport requirements in checked baggage:

  • max. 3 devices larger than a smartphone.
  • Do not pack the device together with easily combustible materials (e.g. perfumes, aerosols, etc.).
  • Switch off the device completely and protect it from unintentional activation.
  • Ensure that apps, alarms or preset configurations are deactivated.
  • Protect the device using suitable packaging or a sturdy bag with sufficient padding.

Power banks are not classed as portable electronic devices. You will find information about taking power banks with you in the section: “Power banks”.

Note:

  • For safety reasons, portable electronic devices must always be visible and accessible when connected to the power supply system of the aircraft.
  • For devices with a battery power greater than 100 Wh up to max. 160 Wh, transport approval from the airline is required.
  • Please register devices and batteries requiring approval when booking flights via the Lufthansa Help Center.
To the Help Center

Permitted in or as checked baggage (not recommended)

Permitted in or as carry-on baggage in the cabin

Portable electronic devices with batteries that DO NOT CONTAIN LITHIUM (e.g. alkaline manganese, zinc carbon, nickel cadmium or nickel metal hydride) for your personal use are:

  • electric toiletry items (toothbrushes, razors, etc.), 
  • electric toys, 
  • drones, watches, calculators; or 
  • other entertainment or communication electronics.

Such items should be carried in your carry-on baggage whenever possible.

Transport requirements in checked baggage: 

  • Switch off the devices completely and protect them from unintentional activation. 
  • Ensure that apps, alarms or preset configurations are deactivated.
  • Protect your device using suitable packaging or a sturdy bag with sufficient padding.
  • If you are transporting several devices, stow your devices separately from each other (e.g. separated by clothing or the original packaging).

Additional transport requirements for non-spillable wet batteries: 

  • Power restriction: max. 12 V / 100 Wh per battery
  • Non-spillable wet batteries (e.g. gel batteries) must not contain free or unabsorbed liquid.

Power banks are not classed as portable electronic devices. You will find information about taking power banks with you in the section: “Power banks”.

Not permitted in or as checked baggage

Permitted in or as carry-on baggage in the cabin

Transport approval required above 100 Wh

Power restriction: max. 100 Wh or 2 g LC per power bank

Item restriction: max. 2 power banks per passenger

Transport regulations:

  • Charging and using power banks is prohibited. An exception is made for use with approved medical devices.

  • Power banks must not be stowed in the overhead locker above the seats. For safety reasons, please store your power banks under the seat in front of you or in its seat pocket, on your person or in your hand luggage.

  • Protect your power bank against damage.
  • Prevent short circuits when not in use, e.g. by placement in original retail packaging or by insulating terminals, such as by taping over exposed terminals or placing every power bank in a separate plastic bag or protective pouch.


Note:

  • For power banks with a battery power greater than 100 Wh up to the maximum. 160 Wh, transport approval from the airline is required.

  • Please register power banks requiring approval when booking flights via the Lufthansa Help Center.

To the Help Center

Not permitted in or as checked baggage

Permitted in or as carry-on baggage in the cabin

Transport approval above 100 Wh / 2 g LC required

Power and item restriction for lithium batteries:

Power restriction            Item restriction Permitted in carry-on baggage Permitted in checked baggage Transport approval required Max. 100 Wh
Max. 2 g LC       20* Yes No No > 100 Wh up to max. 160 Wh 2 Yes No Yes > 2 g LC up to max. 8 g LC 2** Yes No Yes

* The item restriction includes all types of battery, i.e. non-spillable wet batteries, dry batteries, gel batteries, lithium batteries and power banks.

** Only for medical devices

Transport requirements:

With all batteries the connections must be isolated individually to prevent short-circuits. This is possible if the item is carried in its original packaging, any exposed terminals are covered with adhesive tape or each battery is packed in a separate plastic carrier or protective bag.

Power and item restrictions for non-spillable wet batteries: 

  • max. 12 V / 100 Wh per battery
  • max. 2 replacement batteries

Note:

  • The recharging of batteries is not permitted on board.
  • For lithium batteries greater than 100 Wh up to max. 160 Wh and greater than 2 g up to max. 8 g LC, transport approval from the airline is required.
  • Please register batteries requiring approval when booking flights via the Lufthansa Help Center.

Transport prohibited

Battery-powered personal transportation devices mean any small electric vehicle able to transport one person or more.

These include the following devices:

  • hoverboards
  • e-bikes
  • pedelecs/s-pedelecs
  • e-scooters
  • electric monowheels
  • electric baggage scooters (e.g. Modobags or Airwheel)
  • underwater scooters
  • Segways; and
  • electric pushchairs
  • e-skis and e-snowboards
  • eFoils (electric hydrofoil as power add-on for surfboards)

This ban applies irrespective of the power capacity and whether the batteries are permanently attached or are removable, and also applies to battery-powered personal transport devices with no integrated battery.

The above examples only reflect a range of possible devices.

These goods may only be carried as freight in accordance with the IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations.

Transport approval required

For reasons of safety and loadability in the aircraft there are restrictions regarding:

  • the battery power, 
  • the total weight; and
  • the size of the wheelchair or mobility aid.

Note:

  • For safety reasons, wheelchairs with permanently-installed/non-removable lithium batteries are subject to a limit of no more than 2 batteries with a capacity of up to 160 Wh per battery.
  • Transport approval from the airline is required for wheelchairs and mobility aids.
  • Please send us in good time, but 48 hours before departure at the latest, the necessary details (manufacturer’s technical datasheet or manual) about your wheelchair or mobility aid for checking and approval as well as the completed form that is downloadable below to specialcases@dlh.de.

Lufthansa
 
 

Main content

Flight Mode: On. Wi-Fi signal: First Class.

Discover the Lufthansa Group Wi-Fi – powered by Starlink and stay connected for free with your Travel ID or Miles & More service card number.

New high-speed connectivity – wherever you sit

With Lufthansa Group Wi-Fi powered by Starlink, you stay connected at any altitude. Enjoy fast, stable internet thanks to Starlink technology — free of charge and available in every travel class. Watch your favorite shows, stay in touch with your friends and family, or collaborate on documents in real time. With a connection that stays with you seamlessly from gate to destination.

To access Lufthansa Group Wi-Fi, all you need is your Travel ID or Miles & More membership. Our first Airbus A320neo D-AINM with Lufthansa Group Wi-Fi on board takes off for you in mid-August. The rest of our fleet will be equipped gradually.

Create a free Travel ID

Your benefits at a glance

Across all travel classes

From Economy to First Class: fast Wi-Fi for everyone on board.

Free of charge

Simply sign in with your Travel ID or Miles & More account and connect at no extra cost. 

Starlink speed

High-performance internet from Starlink.

For everything you want to do

Whether you're watching films, sending messages, or working, simply go online as usual.

One login, all airlines

Log in once and enjoy internet access on equipped flights across all Lufthansa Group airlines.

On all your devices

Enjoy flexibility, even with several devices at once.

Using Wi-Fi onboard – made simple

Our fast broadband internet opens up countless possibilities on your journey. To ensure a pleasant experience for everyone on board, we kindly ask for your mutual consideration and that you follow the recommendations below for the duration of your flight.

Full volume for you

Enjoy movies, games or music with headphones. Please continue to listen for crew announcements.

Stay in text mode

Please save active voice and video calls for after landing.

Share after landing

Broadcasting of live content is only permitted again once your flight has ended.

Frequently Asked Questions

Lufthansa Group Wi-Fi offers faster, more powerful onboard internet access – free of charge. You can enjoy cloud-based working and other high-bandwidth applications throughout your flight. Compared to FlyNet®, Lufthansa Group Wi-Fi provides a significantly enhanced onboard connectivity experience.

At the beginning of the rollout, Lufthansa Group Wi-Fi is only available on selected aircraft. Therefore, it is not yet possible to check availability before your flight. As the service becomes available on more aircraft, a flight search function will be introduced on the websites of the Lufthansa Group airlines.

If your aircraft is equipped with Lufthansa Group Wi-Fi, follow these steps to connect to the portal:

  1. Enable Flight Mode on your device.
  2. Turn on Wi-Fi.
  3. Connect to the "Lufthansa Group Wi-Fi" network.
  4. Once connected, you will be automatically redirected to the login portal. If the portal does not open automatically, please enter wifi.lufthansa.com in your browser's address bar to access the page.
  5. Follow the instructions in the portal to connect to the internet.

Lufthansa Group Wi-Fi is free of charge for members of a Lufthansa Group loyalty programme and for Travel ID users. If you do not yet have a Travel ID, you can register easily and free of charge, even during your flight.

Yes, you can use Lufthansa Group Wi-Fi on multiple devices simultaneously.

To ensure that all guests can enjoy Lufthansa Group Wi-Fi in a pleasant and relaxed atmosphere, we kindly ask you to follow our behavior policy. By being considerate of your fellow passengers and our crew, you help ensure that everyone can enjoy Lufthansa Group Wi-Fi comfortably throughout the flight.

Please also follow all instructions given by the crew at all times.

No. To maintain a pleasant and quiet atmosphere on board, active participation in voice and video calls are not permitted. However, passive listening to meetings, webinars, or similar events is allowed, provided that you use headphones. You may continue to use messaging services, email, and chat as usual.

Actively recording and transmitting live video content, with or without audio, is not permitted. This includes all forms of live streaming and broadcasting. If you record content for later publication, we kindly ask you to respect the privacy of other guests and the crew and not to record anyone without their consent.

The onboard high-speed internet service provided on Lufthansa Group aircraft is operated in compliance with all applicable data protection laws and regulations governing the protection of personal data.
